# Song2Vid

> Song2Vid is a free app for Mac and Windows that turns one song and one image into an MP4 video. It also has a `song2vid` command for Terminal, scripts and agents.

## Pages

- [Song2Vid - turn a song and an image into a video](https://song2vid.pages.dev/): Song2Vid is a free app for Mac and Windows that turns one song and one image into an MP4 video.
- [song2vid command - Song2Vid docs](https://song2vid.pages.dev/docs/): How to use the song2vid command that comes with Song2Vid for Mac and Windows: install, options, codecs, progress, JSON output and exit statuses.
- [Agent Guide](https://song2vid.pages.dev/agent.md): step-by-step instructions for an agent that finds, installs and uses the command

## Markdown copies
